app.home.title: Stay connected.
app.home.intro: A messaging infrastructure, independent of the Internet or the electric grid, is growing in Finland. The MeshCore network is built by volunteers in cities and rural areas alike. Open to everyone, free of charge, easy to use and inexpensive to get into. Sounds like your thing?
app.home.nextIntro: Comprehensive guides on how to get started with MeshCore and how to get involved in building the network. The FAQ has the settings for Finnish MeshCore and answers to your questions.
app.home.guidesText: Get to know and set up devices, learn about channels and private messages and a whole lot more.
app.home.repeaterText: Hoping to bring MeshCore to your neighbourhood? Read about building and managing repeaters here.
app.home.faqText: Answers to your questions, the settings to use and links to more information.
app.home.activityText: Repeaters are the backbone of the MeshCore network, much like cell phone towers. Packet count shows the magnitude of traffic on the network. On CoreScope you can get an in-depth view of network traffic. You may even read public (not encrypted) messaging.
app.home.communityText: You can participate in making regional coverage maps with the MeshMapper tool. MeshCore Finland's chat is available on Discord, Matrix and WhatsApp – repeater admins in particular are encouraged to join!
app.home.footer: Site run by the Finnish community of MeshCore enthusiasts.
